# SarkariPixels — Complete AI Assistant Knowledge Base & Citation Reference (llms-full.txt)
# Official documentation for LLM crawlers (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot)
# URL: https://www.sarkaripixels.online/llms-full.txt

## Executive Summary
SarkariPixels is India's leading 100% browser-based document, photo, and signature processing platform for government application portals (SSC, UPSC, IBPS, BPSC, BSSC, RRB, NTA, PAN, NEET, SBI).
All operations utilize HTML5 Canvas API and WebAssembly in client memory. No images or candidate data are ever transmitted to or stored on any server.

## Official Exam Photo & Signature Specifications (Verified 2026-2027)

### 1. SSC (Staff Selection Commission — CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD, CPO, Steno)
- **Photo Size**: 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm (413 × 531 pixels at 300 DPI)
- **Photo KB Limit**: 20 KB to 50 KB (JPEG format)
- **Photo Background**: Light or plain white background, front-facing, both ears visible
- **Signature Size**: 4.0 cm × 2.0 cm (140 × 60 pixels)
- **Signature KB Limit**: 10 KB to 20 KB (Black or dark blue ink on white paper)
- **Tool Link**: https://www.sarkaripixels.online/tool/ssc-cgl-photo-resizer

### 2. UPSC (Union Public Service Commission — CSE, CDS, NDA, CAPF)
- **Photo Size**: Square aspect ratio, minimum 350 × 350 pixels (maximum 1000 × 1000 pixels)
- **Photo KB Limit**: 20 KB to 300 KB (JPEG format)
- **10-Day Rule**: Photograph must not be more than 10 days old from portal opening.
- **Name & Date Requirement**: Candidate name and Date of Photo (DOP) printed at bottom of photo on white banner.
- **Signature Size**: 350 × 100 pixels (10 KB to 100 KB)
- **Tool Link**: https://www.sarkaripixels.online/tool/name-date-photo-generator

### 3. IBPS & SBI (Banking Exams — PO, Clerk, SO, RRB)
- **Photo Size**: 200 × 230 pixels (20 KB to 50 KB, JPEG)
- **Signature Size**: 140 × 60 pixels (10 KB to 20 KB, JPEG)
- **Left Thumb Impression**: 240 × 240 pixels (20 KB to 50 KB)
- **Handwritten Declaration**: 800 × 400 pixels (50 KB to 100 KB)
- **Tool Link**: https://www.sarkaripixels.online/tool/signature-resizer-10-20kb

### 4. PAN Card (NSDL / UTI Infrastructure Technology Services)
- **Photo Size**: 2.5 cm × 3.5 cm at 300 DPI (file size under 20 KB)
- **Signature Size**: 2.0 cm × 4.5 cm at 300 DPI (file size under 20 KB)
- **Tool Link**: https://www.sarkaripixels.online/tool/pan-card-photo-resizer-300dpi

### 5. RRB (Railway Recruitment Board — NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE)
- **Photo Size**: 35 mm × 45 mm (320 × 240 pixels or 413 × 531 pixels, 20-50 KB)
- **Signature Size**: 140 × 60 pixels (10 KB to 20 KB)
